scope: Current inquiry handling; shadow preparation only. Not technical electrical standards.

owner-2026-10-09.reference: Implementation request: CURRENT COMMERCIAL STARTING FACTS and POLICY CATEGORIES A-H
owner-2026-10-09.note: Giovanni supplied these current starting facts directly; not inferred from historical cases. Effective date is the draft adoption date, not a claim of earlier validity.

rules: Never ask for already supplied information.
Ask only questions material to the next useful decision; bundle necessary questions.
Separate blocking information, useful non-blocking information and internal questions.
Use existing text, photos and documents for internal electrician/Meister review first; do not push internal technical reasoning onto customers.
A detailed inquiry may suffice for internal review and an estimate without a site visit.
Do not independently certify compatibility or safety.
Identify the exact technical question, assemble evidence and route qualified judgment internally to electrician/Meister.
Customer statements about installations remain unverified customer statements.
Before pricing/execution, internally consider one versus two people using weight, dimensions, height, handling, access, mounting, safety and complexity.
This remains operational/technical judgment; do not ask customers to choose technician count.
Distinguish rough indication, estimate, fixed price, time-and-material, consultation/site-visit fee, customer quote, internal/technician cost, material, travel, final invoice and payment.
Current applicable policy/price book takes precedence over historical prices. Historical prices remain case evidence, never current tariffs or averages.
Never silently convert an estimate to a fixed price; uncertain or conflicting policy requires owner confirmation with both sources retained.
Service-specific fixed prices may exist; applicability must be established. Do not invent their amounts.
When relevant, establish legal ordering party, invoice recipient, company name, billing address, UID/VAT if required and scope/cost-change approver before final commitment/execution.
Material cost/scope increases requiring approval must not appear only on the final invoice. Record approval as confirmed, missing or unknown.
Record responsibility as customer supplies, Elektro Vienna supplies, technician/external partner supplies, or not yet decided.
For customer-supplied devices preserve manufacturer, model and variant where available. Before execution compare delivered model/variant to the technically reviewed one.
A changed model must not silently inherit prior compatibility approval.
Do not default uncertainty to a visit; visit only if remote evidence is insufficient for the next reliable decision.
A paid consultation proposal must state scope, fee and any explicitly agreed credit/deduction rule.

Propose known customer/account, specific job, contact data, address, requested service, technical scope, material missing information, quote state, appointment, assigned technician, execution, invoice, payment and open work.
Retain unknown states and distinguish approval confirmed/missing/unknown. Proposals only; no Airtable writes.
All customer responses are shadow drafts; no Gmail drafts, sending, calendar events or live agent.

team_hour.applicability: Standard two-person team; not a per-person rate.

travel.applicability: Standard travel; do not double-count when included in first hour.

single_first_hour_travel.applicability: Ordinary single-electrician time-based work; includes standard travel.

single_additional_half_hour.applicability: Ordinary single-electrician time-based work; no other rounding/minimum invented.

consultation.applicability: On-site consultation/inspection where this model applies; do not infer additional travel or universal applicability.

consultation_credit.applicability: Only when explicitly agreed for that consultation model and a subsequent job is commissioned; never automatic.

documentation_search.scope: README.md and all docs/*.md, current commercial/price/rate terminology
documentation_search.result: No explicit conflicting CURRENT numeric tariff found. Historical evidence was not used to reconcile or set prices.
